hook_line: AMBANI ADDS $6.3 BILLION IN A DAY AS RELIANCE SHARES JUMP 11.6% ON RECORD QUARTERLY PROFIT

hook_stat.sub: Mukesh Ambani's one-day gain, the biggest on Forbes' real-time billionaires list

news_summary: Mukesh Ambani added $6.3 billion in a single session as Reliance Industries shares surged 11.6% after a stronger-than-expected September quarter, according to Forbes' real-time billionaires list.
payoff: The quarter, not the rich list, is the story — a refining-led beat and record group profit.
